summary.text: Matt Lockett is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 39 who has served since January 1, 2021, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026 against Democrat Ryan Stanford.
He is a financial advisor and a former division director with the Kentucky Department of Insurance.

paragraphs.text: Matt Lockett's career experience includes working as a financial advisor and as a division director with the Kentucky Department of Insurance, and he has volunteered with the National Alzheimer's Association.

In the 2025-2026 session Lockett served on the House Appropriations and Revenue, House Banking and Insurance (as vice chair), Economic Development & Workforce Investment, and Elections, Const. Amendments & Intergovernmental Affairs committees.
